title: Missing security headers
summary: 6 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
problem: 6 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

title: Single-step funnel with dead end
summary: The sole CTA exits to an external documentation site, leaving no in-page next step toward any conversion.
problem: The sole CTA exits to an external documentation site, leaving no in-page next step toward any conversion.
recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Primary in-page action (e.g., Sign up, Request demo); notes: Replace or supplement external link with a conversion-oriented CTA; keep external link as secondary.
evidence: The only call to action on the page is “Learn more”. | Page copy reads “# Example Domain This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations. [Learn more](https://iana.org/domains/example)”.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

title: No value proposition stated

problem: The page copy only describes the domain's purpose for documentation examples and provides no statement of what is sold or why it is better.
recommended_change: h1: Clear value proposition headline; cta: Specific CTA; notes: Replace generic copy with a clear statement of product/service and key benefit.
evidence: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. | Avoid use in operations.
